images.seen: Africa and Middle East at the start: Forces Nouvelles in northern Cote d'Ivoire, Somaliland and Puntland, Western Sahara split between Morocco and the SADR and the Badme hatch look right; no Kurdistan Region land in northern Iraq (Iraq drawn plain) and Curacao, Sint Maarten and Aruba have no owner.

Azawad takes the three northern regions of Mali (3447 Mali cells plus 49 from Mauritania and 2 from Algeria); Cliopatria keeps Mali whole, so the compiled map is the better one; border speckles of Mali brown along Algeria and Niger are cells of the admin-1 line.

Islamic State covers eastern Syria and western and northern Iraq, Kurdistan Region shown only from 2014, Rojava cantons present; a stray United States cell sits at the Turkey-Iraq-Iran tripoint (nobody in the stage after other windows' patches).
Wrong: 84 Iraqi cells (Salah ad-Din, Diyala, Ninawa) as nobody's land, Turkey drawn as owner of Syrian land with Syria's hatch, Idlib as nobody, West Bank nobody's land.
Right: Crimea as Ukrainian land occupied by Russia, DPR and LPR drawn as states, Transnistria and Abkhazia present; grey coast cells are the grid coast, also in Cliopatria.
Right: South Sudan with the Renk lobe, Abyei hatched, Badme hatched, Ilemi triangle left as nobody.
Iraq whole, Kurdistan Region as constituent of Iraq, no grey holes in Iraq.
Afrin, Euphrates Shield and Peace Spring strips drawn as Syrian land hatched with Turkey's colour (34 cells); the wrong-way Turkish-owned hatching is gone.
Kurdistan Region with Kirkuk and the disputed zone, Islamic State and Iraqi contested stripes; two stray nobody cells at the Iran frontier remain from the anchor.
West Bank outside Areas A and B is nobody's land with a reversed 'palestinians' hatch (left, see problems); Yemen with the Houthi north-west looks right.

issues.what: Kurdistan Region owns no land at the p2010 anchor (the three governorates are plain Iraq) until the 2014 keyframe snaps 135 cells in, although its 1992-2013 keyframe and the hierarchy row (constituent, 2005-2026) say it holds them; federal region since 15 October 2005.
The 2014 Kurdistan keyframe discs cross the Iranian frontier (5 cells of Kermanshah) and the Syrian one (1 cell); the 2018 snap then dropped them to nobody.

After Iraq retook the disputed territories (16-31 Oct 2017) 30 Kurdistan cells (Diyala 20, Ninawa 5, Kermanshah 5) of the 2014 discs were never returned and became nobody's land at the 2018 keyframe snap.

Islamic State keyframe 2017 removed 60 cells (Salah ad-Din 59, At-Ta'mim 1) that the ledger never returned: nobody's land from 2017 to 2019. Returned to Iraq on 9 Dec 2017. The pages opened do not date Baiji or Shirqat, and the 2015 and 2016 keyframes still draw Salah ad-Din as Islamic State land, so the hold in 2016-2017 is as the dossier has it.

Turkish occupation of northern Syria drawn the wrong way round: Turkey's occupation_start discs (ledger/7, 8, 9) and Syria's (ledger/17, 20, 22) cross the frontier, so the compiler made Turkey the owner and Syria the occupier (40 cells, 9+17+1 Turkish cells hatched), and the Islamic State and AANES ledgers hand Jarabulus, al-Bab, Afrin and the Tell Abyad-Ras al-Ayn strip to Turkey as direct land (34 cells). Now Syria owns them, occupied by Turkey, from Aug 2016 (4 cells), Feb 2017 (12), Mar 2018 (9) and Oct 2019 (9); the wrong-way relation is closed after each start.

The netherlands-antilles 1986 keyframe still holds 5 stray cells in South America (3 in Para, Brazil; 1 at Paramaribo; 1 on the Suriname-Guyana coast) that became nobody's land at the dissolution on 10 October 2010. Three given back to Brazil and one to Suriname; the coastal Corantijn cell is left (Suriname or Guyana not decidable).
Curacao (3 cells), Sint Maarten (1) and Aruba (1) have no dossier: their cells become nobody's land on 10 Oct 2010 (Aruba already at the p2010 anchor).

Al-Shabaab has no dossier; the page says it 'controlled most of central and southern Somalia' by 2009-10, lost Mogadishu (Aug 2011) and Kismayo (Oct 2012) and then held rural areas 'semi-territorially'. The map shows all of Somalia as the Federal Republic of Somalia.

Syrian opposition has no dossier: the Syria ledger gives Raqqa (2013), Idlib (2015), Aleppo and Ghouta to 'syrian-opposition'; 20 cells of Idlib are nobody's land from 2015 to the end, and 41 Raqqa cells in 2013.

Hasakah 2012: the AANES 2012 keyframe snap drops 75 Hasakah cells to nobody for the end of 2012; AANES and the Islamic State take them back from nobody in 2013 (47 and 22). A patch giving them to Syria would starve the 2013 gains, which draw only from nobody's land.
Egypt wins the 86 Red Sea cells (Hala'ib) against Sudan's 2011 shape: Egypt administers the triangle, Sudan claims it.

Azawad takes 49 cells from Mauritania and 2 from Algeria in 2012 (Timbuktu admin-1 cells those states hold at the anchor); Mali gets all 3500 back in Feb 2013 (Mauritania 4176 -> 4127, Mali +53 for good). Kidal stayed outside government control after Feb 2013, but the dossier's end date for Azawad is 14 Feb 2013.
Badme occupation by Ethiopia stays open to the end of the window; the dossier dates its end to 2020 from the infobox ('until the 2020 Tigray War').

The Islamic State/Iraq contest opened on 30 Dec 2013 covers 864 cells (all of Anbar, Salah ad-Din, Ninawa, At-Ta'mim at the end of 2013): the region is the governorates the infobox names, wider than the land fought over.

West Bank outside Areas A and B is nobody's land for the whole window, and the occupation relation is reversed ('occupation of state-of-israel's land by palestinians', 3 cells, since 1988). Comes from the 1967-1988 anchor, not from this window.

compile-order notes for dossier editors: occupation_start decides owner and occupier by which party holds more cells in the region, so discs that cross a frontier invert the roles (republic-of-turkey/ledger/7, 8, 9; syria/ledger/17, 20, 22); the fix is an {intersect: [disc, {country: Syria}]} region. In a patch, a start and a gain of two dossiers in one month are ordered by dossier, and an occupation_end runs before an occupation_start of the same month, so the wrong-way relation is closed in the month after the start.
After the patch, 'republic-of-turkey's land by syria' still exists briefly (Jan-Feb 2018 and Oct-Nov 2019) before the closing events; year-end maps are clean.
Hierarchy: none wrong found for this window (kurdistan-region of republic-of-iraq, constituent, 2005-2026, confidence 2, is right; it only had no land before this patch).
